title: Ice crystal habit
help: Pick the habit that best describes the particle. Add flags for extra features. If you can't tell, use 'Can't tell' rather than guessing.

classes.name: Droplet
classes.desc: Liquid drop: a near-perfect circle with a smooth edge, usually with a bright spot or ring in the middle where it focuses the light.

classes.name: Quasi-sphere
classes.desc: Round but not quite a perfect circle, no bright centre: frozen drop or small quasi-spherical ice.

classes.name: Column
classes.desc: Hexagonal prism longer than wide, flat ends, solid or hollow.

classes.name: Needle
classes.desc: Very long thin column (aspect ratio above about 5).

classes.name: Plate
classes.desc: Thin hexagonal plate or sectored plate.

classes.name: Bullet rosette
classes.desc: Several columns or bullets radiating from one centre.

classes.name: Capped column
classes.desc: Column with plates on one or both ends.

classes.name: Graupel / rimed
classes.desc: Heavily rimed, original habit hidden; lumpy outline.

classes.name: Too small to tell
classes.desc: Only a few pixels across; habit can't be judged.

classes.name: Can't tell / blurred
classes.desc: Out of focus, overlapping, or otherwise unclassifiable.

classes.name: Artefact
classes.desc: Not a cloud particle: shattering debris, streaks, smudges, stuck particle, empty ROI.

flags.name: Rimed
flags.desc: Some riming visible on the crystal.

flags.name: Fragment
flags.desc: Broken piece of a larger crystal.

flags.name: Cut off
flags.desc: Particle runs off the edge of the image.

flags.name: Unsure
flags.desc: Your best guess, but you're not confident.
